integrity: The proof is a direct module-theoretic derivation from explicitly cited identities in the motivating source. No finite computation is represented as a proof of the universal statement, and the generalized-inverse literature risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem retains all three module-theoretic hypotheses of the motivating arbitrary-ring result; no claim is made under its weaker stably-finite hypotheses.
The generalized-inverse transfer proves existence and gives a natural transferred inverse but does not classify every generalized inverse of the large matrix.
The finite-field executable is a consistency check only; the arbitrary-ring statement is supported by the symbolic proof.
title: Exact singular-defect transfer for structured perturbations over arbitrary rings
